purpose: Close the remaining CORE-01 crash-consistency gap by making canonical profile initialization all-or-nothing and fault-injecting existing SQLite persistence for process interruption, disk-full rollback and interrupted evidence migration without inventing another persistence model.

lineage.outcome: The artist's last committed canonical Artist/Song state survives ordinary interruption, and damaged state fails visibly/recoverably instead of becoming trusted partial state.

completion_proof: a denied mid-initialization schema operation rolls back every canonical schema object rather than leaving a trusted partial profile
a subprocess terminated after an uncommitted Song mutation reopens to the exact prior committed Song state with quick_check ok
SQLITE_FULL during a large transactional Song write rolls back the mutation and preserves prior active Song, row count and integrity
an interrupted evidence v1-to-v2 migration rolls back both ALTER TABLE and metadata change, remains retryable as v1, then migrates to v2 without claim loss
existing CORE-01F corrupt-live tests continue to require explicit exact-hash snapshot restore and preserve the corrupt database rather than silently replacing it

same-class scan confirms Activity, context imports, provenance and normal evidence mutations use the canonical transaction boundary; evidence schema creation begins its transaction inside executescript
after fault proof, the full CORE-01 parent is re-audited rather than extending persistence work by adjacency
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01J fault evidence, re-audit CORE-01. If no concrete parent foundation gap remains, close the construction dependency and globally reselect from newly dependency-ready nodes rather than continuing persistence by adjacency.
